lines.text: David summoned all Israel's leaders to Jerusalem and said he had wanted to build a house for the ark.
God said David could not build the house because he was a man of war, and chose Benjamin as leader.
God chose Solomon from David's many sons to build His house and promised his kingdom forever if he obeyed.
David told Solomon to serve God wholeheartedly, since the LORD searches every heart, and to be strong and build.
David told Solomon that the LORD made all the details of the plan clear to him in a dream.
